parliament.name: Hungarian Parliament Building
parliament.price_text: Guided tours for non-EU visitors roughly HUF 5,000–10,000; check on the day
parliament.hours: Visitor centre usually 08:00–18:00 in season; book ahead
parliament.tip: Book a guided tour online days ahead and bring your passport for security.
parliament.best: Morning tour, then walk the Danube bank

buda-castle.name: Buda Castle
buda-castle.price_text: Castle grounds free; museums charge separately
buda-castle.hours: Grounds always open; museum hours vary
buda-castle.tip: Walk the grounds at sunset for the best view across to Pest.

fishermans-bastion.name: Fisherman's Bastion
fishermans-bastion.price_text: Terrace free; upper turrets may have a small fee, check on the day
fishermans-bastion.tip: Come before 09:00 to beat the crowds on the terraces.

chain-bridge.name: Széchenyi Chain Bridge
chain-bridge.tip: Walk it at night when the bridge and castle are lit up.

st-stephens.name: St. Stephen's Basilica
st-stephens.price_text: Small entry donation; dome lift extra, check on the day
st-stephens.hours: Roughly 09:00–17:00 Mon–Sat, Sunday afternoons; check on the day
st-stephens.tip: Climb the dome for a 360° view over Pest.

heroes-square.name: Heroes' Square
heroes-square.tip: Pair it with a walk down Andrássy Avenue or into City Park.

szechenyi-baths.name: Széchenyi Thermal Baths
szechenyi-baths.price_text: Day ticket roughly HUF 8,000–12,000 depending on day; check on the day
szechenyi-baths.hours: Usually 07:00–19:00 or 20:00; check on the day
szechenyi-baths.tip: Bring flip-flops and a towel, or rent them there; weekdays are quieter.

zoo.name: Budapest Zoo & Botanical Garden
zoo.price_text: Adult ticket roughly HUF 4,000–5,000; check on the day
zoo.hours: Usually 09:00–17:00 or later in summer; check on the day
zoo.tip: Good for families; combine with Heroes' Square next door.

danube-river.name: Danube River
danube-river.tip: The Pest embankment is best at sunset and after dark.

danube-sightseeing.name: Danube River Sightseeing
danube-sightseeing.price_text: Cruises roughly HUF 5,000–15,000 depending on length and drinks; check on the day
danube-sightseeing.hours: Departures through the day and evening
danube-sightseeing.tip: Take an evening cruise to see the lit-up Parliament from the water.

dohany-synagogue.name: Dohány Street Synagogue
dohany-synagogue.price_text: Entry roughly HUF 5,000–7,000; check on the day
dohany-synagogue.hours: Closed Saturday; weekday hours vary, check on the day
dohany-synagogue.tip: Men need a head covering; a simple kippah is provided at the door.

gellert-hill.name: Gellért Hill
gellert-hill.tip: Climb to the Citadel for the best panorama of the city.

goulash.name: Goulash
goulash.price_text: A bowl in a mid-range restaurant roughly HUF 2,500–4,500
goulash.tip: Try it as a soup in a traditional restaurant, not just as a stew.

great-market-hall.name: Great Market Hall
great-market-hall.price_text: Free to enter; food priced per stall
great-market-hall.hours: Closed Sunday; roughly 06:00–18:00 Mon–Fri, shorter Saturday; check on the day
great-market-hall.tip: Go upstairs for cheap street food and paprika to take home.

godollo-palace.name: Gödöllő Palace
godollo-palace.price_text: Entry roughly HUF 3,000–5,000; check on the day
godollo-palace.hours: Usually 10:00–17:00 or 18:00; closed Mondays, check on the day
godollo-palace.tip: It is a day trip outside the city; allow half a day with the train.

house-of-terror.name: House of Terror
house-of-terror.price_text: Entry roughly HUF 3,000–4,000; check on the day
house-of-terror.hours: Closed Mondays; usually 10:00–18:00; check on the day
house-of-terror.tip: Heavy subject matter; allow two hours and go early.

opera-house.name: Hungarian State Opera House
opera-house.price_text: Tickets vary widely; guided tours roughly HUF 3,000–5,000
opera-house.hours: Box office daytime; performances in the evening
opera-house.tip: Book a performance or a daytime tour to see the ornate hall.

matthias-church.name: Matthias Church
matthias-church.price_text: Entry roughly HUF 2,000–3,000; check on the day
matthias-church.hours: Usually 09:00–17:00; closed to tourists during mass
matthias-church.tip: Visit early and combine with Fisherman's Bastion next door.

mupa.name: Müpa Budapest
mupa.price_text: Tickets vary by event; check the programme
mupa.hours: Box office daytime; events in the evening
mupa.tip: Check the programme for concerts; it is a short tram ride south of the centre.

puskas-arena.name: Puskás Arena
puskas-arena.price_text: Tours and match tickets vary; check on the day
puskas-arena.tip: Only worth it for a match or a stadium tour; book ahead.

shoes-danube.name: Shoes on the Danube Bank
shoes-danube.tip: A short, moving stop on the Pest embankment; visit at dusk.

ruin-bar-tour.name: Ruin bar evening in the Jewish Quarter
ruin-bar-tour.hours: Bars usually open from evening until late
ruin-bar-tour.tip: Start early on a weekday; the famous spots get packed on weekends.

central-market-food.name: Central Market Hall food stalls
central-market-food.tip: Cheap lángos and sausages upstairs; go before noon.

citadel-viewpoint.name: Citadel viewpoint on Gellért Hill
citadel-viewpoint.tip: Bring water; the climb takes about 20 minutes from the river.

castle-walk.name: Castle District walk
castle-walk.tip: Wander the quiet side streets behind Matthias Church away from the crowds.

thermal-bath-activity.name: Thermal bath soak (Rudas or Gellért)
thermal-bath-activity.price_text: Tickets roughly HUF 6,000–12,000; check on the day
thermal-bath-activity.hours: Usually daytime into evening; check on the day
thermal-bath-activity.tip: Rudas has a rooftop pool with a river view; bring a swim cap if required.

jewish-quarter-walk.name: Jewish Quarter street walk
jewish-quarter-walk.tip: See the synagogue, murals and ruin bars on foot in an hour or two.

andrssy.name: Andrássy Avenue
andrssy.tip: Walk from the Opera House up to Heroes' Square for the full stretch.
